about: Retention verdict of every HTTP path. protected: every YouTube field is checked against its own clock (29 days) before it leaves the server; partial: some fields are not, see gaps; unprotected: none checked; no_youtube_data: only IDs, user work or operational state. A new route needs a review and an entry here.

gaps.inventory_freshness: The inventory view and count estimate each have a freshness window and require independent checks.
gaps.saved_collection_window: Saved collection pages validate source_expires_at against checked_at and the allowed source window.

POST /research/queries/execute.reads: registered SQL source clocks including unreturned predicate/sort dependencies; final scope, owner and HOT recheck; response lifetime

POST /research/queries/frozen-ids.reads: Row IDs of one process-local frozen result only; every source it admitted outlives the result; owner context and scope revision rechecked on each access; response lifetime is the result's valid_before

POST /research/queries/validate.reads: bounded query validation; no source read

GET /research/capabilities.reads: effective owner query capabilities; no source read

GET /sidebar-user-data.reads: readable.channel_user_work local identities/folder membership; local folders and labels only; no API payload or source clock

GET /saved/collections/{collection_id}/m.reads: local saved collection metadata, revision and member video IDs with user save times; never loads API sources

GET /system/video-type-reviews/hidden.reads: R04B: retained video/channel IDs and their count only; no API title, type, thumbnail or clock. No review task is created.

GET /internal/hot-runtime.reads: signed maintenance status for the collector

GET /internal/update-status.reads: signed source-free update hold, handoff and readiness status

GET /explorer/channel-library/video-chan.reads: video -> channel ID mapping from hot_video_inventory, source_is_current(source_checked_at); IDs only

GET /explorer/home-summary.reads: typed inventory counts from hot_video_inventory with min(source_checked_at) admission; sync run times; read cache 20 s

GET /sidebar-data.reads: readable channels via channel_source_fields (profile, country and per-type estimate clocks); folders/labels; view witness admitted before read cache

GET /channels/{channel_id}/explorer/prof.reads: readable channel profile by channel_metadata_checked_at/status; country by country_collected_at; Python masks and response deadline retained

GET /channels/{channel_id}/explorer/list.reads: visible channel guard; one bounded count read of readable list state, scan sources and memberships (counts only); YouTube video count only from a fresh channel profile; earliest witness registered and carried as the proof's expiry

GET /channels/{channel_id}/backfill-curr.reads: operator job snapshot; summary and error hidden after requested_at + 29 days

GET /channels/{channel_id}/videos/long/b.reads: operator job snapshot; summary and error hidden after requested_at + 29 days

POST /channels/{channel_id}/backfill-cur.reads: queues a job; operator job snapshot

POST /channels/{channel_id}/videos/long/.reads: queues a job; operator job snapshot

GET /channels/{channel_id}/hydration.reads: estimate by per-type clock, admitted job snapshot; per-format counts from readable inventory/memberships/video fields and admitted scan evidence; earliest witness registered

POST /channels/{channel_id}/explorer/lis.reads: owner work only; queues or joins one full check

POST /channels/{channel_id}/hydration.reads: estimate by per-type clock, admitted job snapshot; per-format counts from readable inventory/memberships/video fields and admitted scan evidence; earliest witness registered

POST /add-channel.reads: Mutation acknowledgement is re-read through FrontendRepository/readable channels in the worker thread; both profile and top-level title use admitted fields.

POST /starter-channels/add.reads: Mutation acknowledgement is re-read through FrontendRepository/readable channels in the worker thread; both profile and top-level title use admitted fields.

GET /system-summary.reads: sync run aggregates, queue counts, quota ledger of the current day, open review flag

GET /system/run-history.reads: ten compact stored sync runs only; no queue, quota or type diagnostics

GET /system/websub.reads: WebSub subscription, delivery and event counts and the public callback host; no video or channel values

GET /system/pipeline-health.reads: operational aggregates and quota ledger of the current day

GET /system/video-type-reviews.reads: Readable case observations and inventory type; manual decisions/history are retained user work; case deadlines constrain the response.

GET /system/video-type-reviews/{case_id}.reads: Readable case observations and inventory type; manual decisions/history are retained user work; case deadlines constrain the response.

POST /system/video-type-reviews/{case_id.reads: Readable case observations and inventory type; manual decisions/history are retained user work; case deadlines constrain the response.

GET /telemetry/recent.reads: telemetry events: operation names, counts, error classes

GET /telemetry/stream.reads: telemetry events: operation names, counts, error classes

GET /diagnostics/discovery-journal.reads: Owner-only bounded local journal: installation-keyed video/channel/work references, operation/status codes, timestamps and loss counters. No raw identities, source fields, payloads or exception text; pre/post owner rechecks and no-store response. Diagnostics never establish source freshness or exposure.

POST /diagnostics/discovery-journal/brow.reads: Owner-only same-origin report with at most 50 indices into an issued, delivered, unexpired in-memory read receipt. Duplicate received/rendered client reports are ignored; accepts no source fields, performs no source read and returns an empty 204. Reports never change domain visibility or exposure.

POST /saved/views/translate.reads: Library v1 conditions in the request body translated into one shared query; no database or source read

GET /saved/collections.reads: collection names and member counts (user work)

POST /saved/collections.reads: collection names and member counts (user work)

GET /saved/collections/{collection_id}.reads: collection names and member counts (user work)

PATCH /saved/collections/{collection_id}.reads: collection names and member counts (user work)

DELETE /saved/collections/{collection_id.reads: collection names and member counts (user work)

GET /saved/collections/{collection_id}/m.reads: Readable source projections; type evidence and metadata/status freshness precede dependent reason codes; earliest witness deadline is registered.

GET /user-work/status.reads: restore state: IDs and typed locators

POST /user-work/backup.reads: backup export: IDs and user work only

POST /user-work/pending/reconnect.reads: durable reconnect intent receipt; no provider work

POST /user-work/pending/{item_id}/resolv.reads: durable single reconnect intent receipt; no provider work

GET /user-work/deleted-channels/titles.reads: Optional bounded titles from readable.channels for hidden user-work IDs only; profile admission and source_expires_at retained independently of the source-free trash list.

GET /research/fields.reads: User-owned field preferences, Saved definition dependencies and storage byte/count estimates only; no API field payload.

POST /research/fields/preview.reads: User-owned field preferences, Saved definition dependencies and storage byte/count estimates only; no API field payload.

POST /research/fields/apply.reads: User-owned field preferences, Saved definition dependencies and storage byte/count estimates only; no API field payload.

POST /research/operations/execute.reads: Registered whole-population SQL over the same readable sources and dependency clocks; definition-epoch fence, operation gate, final scope/owner/HOT checks and source lifetime.

POST /research/graphs/execute.reads: Bounded sequential query/operation execution through QueryService; per-block lifetimes, final scope/access fence, earliest result expiry; no results persisted.

POST /research/graphs/validate.reads: Bounded graph and registry validation; user definition only, no source data read.

POST /mcp.reads: MCP protocol envelope only; every tool call re-enters the protected research routes with the same agent key.

GET /mcp.reads: Answers 405: no server stream; reads nothing.

GET /agent-keys.reads: Agent key names and lifetimes from the private key store; no source data.

POST /agent-keys.reads: Creates one agent key in the private key store; no source data.

DELETE /agent-keys/{key_id}.reads: Removes one agent key from the private key store; no source data.

GET /agent-connections.reads: Owner-approved agent connection names and lifetimes from the private store; no source data.

DELETE /agent-connections/{connection_id.reads: Removes one owner-approved agent connection and its tokens; no source data.

GET /oauth/authorize.reads: Agent sign-in request and the Allow page; registration data only, no source data.

POST /oauth/authorize.reads: The owner's Allow or Deny; issues a one-time code, no source data.

GET /sources/registry.reads: Provider registry projection (methods, fields, support states); documentation metadata only, no YouTube data, no code paths.

GET /sources/acquisitions/status.reads: Daily one-off acquisition cap: quota ledger units of the current Pacific day and per-acquisition limits; operational counts only.

POST /sources/acquisitions/preview.reads: Pure request plan and worst-case cost from the registry plus the daily cap reading; no provider request, no source read.

POST /sources/acquisitions/execute.reads: Fresh provider pages held in request memory only; every value is observed by this request (response Date clock), nothing is stored, cached or read from storage; the only write is the quota ledger attempt.

GET /research/contracts.reads: Schema, policy-filtered registry help and synthetic examples; no YouTube values

GET /research/sources.reads: Bounded folder/label/collection IDs and user names only; agent or owner authorization rechecked after read

/setup/status.reads: setup state; category reference status (language count, expiry)

/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server.reads: agent sign-in: metadata; no library data

/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource.reads: agent sign-in: metadata; no library data

/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mc.reads: agent sign-in: metadata; no library data

/oauth/register.reads: agent sign-in: client registration; no library data

/oauth/token.reads: agent sign-in: code and refresh token exchange; no library data
